text:
maria.marketing: Draft one-pager for enterprise launch is ready in Figma and PDF. Need quick review + final inbound routing logic before Friday. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz :rocket:

sam.field: :eyes: I'll prioritize. Key asks: add a short security callout and a govcloud example. Also prefer including cost/latency tradeoffs.

ava.product: I'll add a one-line 'rollback & fallback' note for Dedicated -> Hosted fallback. Think a single-line table works.

jon.engineering: Quick flag — benchmark numbers are from internal CI runs, so we should label them 'indicative'. I'll add 95th-percentile latency + batched throughput figures.

isabel.sales: For inbound routing, propose: if company_size >= 1000 or security=true => route to AE-enterprise queue + open Private deploy track. Otherwise SDR. Proposed rule snippet:
```
if form.enterprise == true or form.security_requirements == 'high':
  route_to = 'AE-enterprise'
  tag = 'private-deploy-track'
else:
  route_to = 'SDR'
```

ops-bot: Webinar slot confirmed — Apr 12, 10am PT. Landing page: https://events.redwood.com/enterprise-launch :calendar:

maria.marketing: Nice. Also need three headline options for social + a 1-line value prop for demo script. Quick ideas?

sam.field: 1) 'SLA-backed inference across cloud & on-prem' 2) 'Secure, predictable LLM serving for regulated teams' 3) 'Lower unit cost with predictable latency'

isabel.sales: Prefer option 2 for enterprise outreach. For AE scripts we need a 1-line that combines security + rollout speed.

ava.product: Draft one-liner: 'Pin model versions, route by latency policy, and fail gracefully to maintain SLAs.' Keep it micro.

jon.engineering: +1. I'll drop the 95p numbers into an appendix PDF and add a short note on quantization recommendations for cost-sensitive workloads.

maria.marketing: Plan: finalize one-pager + routing snippet + webinar landing by Tue EOD. If no objections I'll push to design and start registration. :thumbsup:
